results.title: All Pass
results.overview: Three families from different parts of North Chennai come together through circumstances and, despite financial struggles, decide to live under one roof in Sathya Nagar. Their friendship grows into a close-knit bond, with the three families living like one. But when a conflict threatens this unity and puts their relationships at risk, they must face its consequences and decide whether their bond can survive.

results.title: A Sucker's Born Every Minute
results.overview: Toni, once a famous singer, now has gambling debts and struggles to make ends meet. His luck changes when Malena, a former lover, introduces him to Junior, a wealthy young man, ready to hire him to steal a priceless painting from his own mother. To carry out this supposedly easy heist, Toni recruits a clumsy crew, forming a team in which each one pursues their own interests.

results.title: Flying Colors
results.overview: Belén, a 17-year-old who uses a wheelchair, feels she is being left behind as her friends plan their futures outside of school. Her rebelliousness leads her to an adapted athletics club, where she meets Laura, a Paralympic athlete who inspires her to reconnect with her body and confidence. Belén will discover that growing up is not about following the path of others, but about building her own, even if in a different way.

results.title: Enna Vilai
results.overview: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

results.title: The Devil Within
results.overview: Spain, 1980s. Philippe is a ten-year-old French boy traveling with his very pregnant mother, Marie, and his father, Tomas, whose plan is to take them home to the village where he grew up and introduce the boy to his Spanish roots. But an unfortunate breakdown leads the family to a scrapyard on the outskirts of a deserted inland town, where they come upon its owners, Alicia and Miguel.

results.title: Untitled Home Invasion Romance
results.overview: As a last-ditch attempt to save his failing marriage, an actor stages a home invasion during a romantic getaway weekend.

results.title: Cocktail 2
results.overview: A vacation in Sicily forces longtime partners Diya and Kunal to question their love and commitment after they reunite with Diya's old friend Ally.

results.title: Sagaran
results.overview: As female motorcycle racer Mica and her mechanic boyfriend Migo join a motor shop's team, they try to navigate a new set of complicated relationships that'll push them to the limit.

results.title: Fuego amigo
results.overview: Andrés is a veteran of the Malvinas War. He works at the family transportation company. News arrives that the EAAF?the Argentine Forensic Anthropology Team?has identified the remains of his friend Damián, who fell in battle. He has started smoking again. A delegation is being organized to travel to the Islands and attend the ceremony. An old pang of guilt torments him: when Damián fell, he was a few meters behind him, firing his weapon. He always knew it wasn?t him, but the specter of friendly fire casts a shadow over his memory.

results.title: Lenin Pandiyan
results.overview: Set alongside on the riverbanks of Maanamadurai in the Sivagangai district, the premise is about a very gullible, innocent old couple in their late 60s, 70s who inadvertently get intertwined in the political lobby of sand mining which is currently a major issue in the local district.

results.title: Poeksie Woeksie
results.overview: A spin-off of the beloved comedy series, Orkney Snork Nie. Chaos ensues when Ouboet finds himself behind bars, despite being innocent. While Yollie deals with the family crisis, he must prove his innocence to make it home in time for his son’s wedding.

results.title: Mardaani 3
results.overview: Officer Shivani Shivaji Roy returns to hunt down those behind the disappearance of young girls, risking everything to bring them back alive.

results.title: Clean Hands
results.overview: Based on a true story, a veteran narcotics officer turned recovery advocate and his daughter, who struggles with addiction, confront the American drug crisis from opposing sides of the law while navigating their complicated family bond.

results.title: Alas Roban
results.overview: After a terrifying night forces them on a perilous journey through the eerie forests of Alas Roban, a mother and her young daughter must face relentless, otherworldly horrors to uncover the ancient secret haunting the land.

results.title: Propeller One-Way Night Coach
results.overview: During the golden age of aviation, a young airplane enthusiast and his mother embark on a cross-country journey to Hollywood—and their simple flight transforms into the trip of a lifetime.

results.title: Mononoke the Movie: Chapter III - The Curse of the Serpent
results.original_title: 劇場版モノノ怪 第三章 蛇神
results.overview: When tragedy strikes within the walls of the Ōoku, twisted human passions and festering grudges spawn the Medicine Seller's most fearsome opponent yet.

results.title: Queen at Sea
results.overview: As advanced dementia erodes an older woman's ability to communicate her inner life, her husband and daughter struggle to act in her best interests, navigating love and the fragile boundaries between care, protection and autonomy.

results.title: Perfect Soul
results.overview: Guided by mysterious entities who claim to be family, Nikki is shown the haunting secrets of her town, her parents and friends. Her faith is put to the test and sends her spiraling down a path of insanity, for which there may be no escape.

results.title: Yooper Frankenstein
results.overview: A young researcher travels to Michigan's Upper Peninsula not knowing that the science project she's working on will descend into a nightmare that will have her fighting for her life.
